# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_VOLUME_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-16
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a volume confirmation filter (current 5m bar volume > 20-bar average volume) to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will improve edge capture by filtering out low-volume breakdowns that are more likely to fail, thus reducing losses on losing J days while preserving wins on winning J days.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON remains unchanged, but we add a pre-entry condition: the volume of the trigger bar (the 5m bar that prints the level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, and confluence) must be greater than the average volume of the prior 20 bars. If not, the entry is skipped.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Tested on 16-month SPY 5m data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Selection method: all bars that trigger the base BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup. Overfit risk: medium (single parameter: volume lookback period).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill simulation not performed)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: if volume filter causes us to skip a big winner (e.g., 5/04 if volume was low that day), we could lose the entire winner. Max drawdown: could increase if we skip winners and keep losers. Blow-up scenario: if the volume filter is miscalibrated and we skip all winners while keeping losers.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X. unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>

Gym validators must pass, walk-forward OOS must be positive, real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show <20% deviation from BS sim, concentration check (top5_pct < 200%), and no regression on J anchor days (edge_capture >= current edge_capture on J winners).
